thesis_points: AI cluster build-outs keep demand for 800G and 1.6T optical transceivers ahead of supply through 2027.
Liquid-cooled rack systems widen the addressable market beyond optics and grew faster than optics in fiscal 2025.
Trades at a discount to optical and thermal peers on trailing earnings despite faster revenue growth.
key_risks: Customer concentration: a handful of hyperscale buyers drive most revenue.
Co-packaged optics could shrink the pluggable-module market over time.
Export controls on advanced computing items limit sales to some regions.
rating_policy: Only the CIO Office changes the rating. AI drafts may flag 'needs strategist review' with reasons but cannot propose a rating.
